verdict.rationale: Neon serves a live root llms.txt and a docs-level llms.txt index, and docs pages are available as .md with summaries. It also ships an LLM-addressed Management API index with per-endpoint .md pages and an OpenAPI link, plus agent-addressed runbooks (auth.md) and SKILL.md agent skills. Hands-on probes confirm HTTP 200 for llms.txt, the .md docs and the API llms.txt, corroborating the first-party documentation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: an LLM-addressed index of every Management API endpoint with per-endpoint .md pages and the OpenAPI spec link
Agent Skills are structured context files (SKILL.md) that give AI coding assistants accurate knowledge of Neon's platform, APIs, SDKs, and best practices
neon.com/auth.md is an agent-addressed provisioning runbook
